title: Click (2016)
summary: An interactive website experiment where every user click is captured and used as training data for AI behavior learning, creating a gamified human-AI interaction where users explore and contribute to a collective behavioral dataset.
problem_solved: Provides a unique way to collect human behavioral data through gamification for training AI systems.
why_valuable: It demonstrates how collective human behavior can be captured and used to train AI models through an engaging, interactive experience that makes data collection fun rather than intrusive.
